name: @emgloop/infra-connections
description: The connections worker environment on AWS (Teams/Telegram durable worker) plus the creator-media signer. A separate deployable, not an npm workspace, so the web build never installs it. Two stages, staging and production, deployed only through connections-infra-deploy.yml.

scripts.synth:production: tsx scripts/bundle.ts && CONNECTIONS_SYNTH_OFFLINE=1 cdk synth --quiet --no-notices -c stage=production -c productionAccount=123456789012 -c alertEmail=alerts@example.invalid
